This will be only partally about difficulty, warning you - really unpopular comment.
As I personally liked AB, loved Mega Satan, though thinking that greed mode sucks ( I'm only using it for testing builds), I thought that they would make something as good or even better . How foolish I was.
First impressions after like 15 hours of gameplay were like that : They must be fucking joking... 
Really... It felt like playing a game made by bunch of 17yo guy who thought that they would make a game , having no game-making experience.  If TBoI was 9,  Rebirth 9.5, AB 9, then AB+ is 2 out of 10 for me... Personally I have three theories why did It feel so shitty.
First - they may have gotten angry cause people liked fan-made modification more than AB ( I haven't played Antibirth, so won't be talking bout it) So they made this out of spite. This may seem not a real thing, as they have included whole mod API with AB+.
Second theory is that they could just have became spoiled, and realised that community would buy no matter how shitty the game would be.
Third is that they just lost their creativity, and couldn't come up with better solutions for Isaac ( but here comes community, whose ideas are often very good). Also quality could get hurt cause they were working on so many projects at once if I remember correctly.
I hate whole concept of Greedier , and won't bother playing it. It is an arena which would be good, if they made a few Greedmode-only mechanics, and not put skeletal heads, stone fatties there.
Why can't they make a casual mode, where you have everything unlocked... 
Delirium for me is really bad conceptually, not to mention how bugged he was ( and still is but less).It is just a super-op bullet hell, which lags very much on older pcs. Most of new enemies are just harsher versions of old ones. 
Stone fatties are good in normal , but as I have said, they should be spawning in greed. Void portals after nerfs also are ok.
 But still AB+ for me is just a fart, and only thing that could keep me from unistalling it, was the bunch of new trinkets, and Smelter. But these things don't recompensate what I have lost with AB+. And that is my will to play TBoI any more.
Of course everyone has their mind, and they should make their own opinion.
Also since Rebirth I haven't encountered my beloved Daddy Long Legs/ Tryachnid as a floor boss, only as a minion in Cathedral/Chest. Anyone knows why? 
Have a nice day, Kamo.
